display.purpose: Page titles and strongest prose entry points.

body.purpose: Long-form technical explanation within a 72ch measure.

motion.name: functional-fast
motion.purpose: Color, opacity, focus, and compact disclosure transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact primary action with a single violet signal.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius, 0); background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 12px/1 Inter, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action defined by structure rather than fill.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius, 0); background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font: 500 12px/1 Inter, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-button-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Compact repository and command input with explicit focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 32px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: var(--radius, 0); background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font: 400 12px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Documentation Navigation
components.description: Compact route list with an accent-toned active location.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 2px; width: 220px; padding: 8px; background: var(--sidebar); font: 400 13px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { padding: 6px 8px; color: var(--sidebar-foreground); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-nav a:hover { background: var(--sidebar-accent); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--sidebar-ring); outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-nav a.is-active { background: var(--sidebar-accent); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground); font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Code Block
components.description: Flat bordered code surface for commands and source examples.
components.css: .ds-code { overflow-x: auto; margin: 0; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--code-block-border); border-radius: var(--radius, 0); background: var(--code-block); color: var(--code-block-foreground); font: 400 14px/1.5 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; } .ds-code:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Table of Contents Item
components.description: Muted document location that becomes violet when active.
components.html: Start a projectGrow incrementally
components.css: .ds-toc { display: grid; font: 400 14px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-toc a { padding: 4px 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-toc a:hover { color: var(--foreground); } .ds-toc a:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-toc a.is-active { color: var(--primary); font-weight: 500; }

narrative.overview: The current Stack Effect documentation is a quiet technical workspace. It uses monospaced headings, cool neutral surfaces, fine structural borders, and a single violet signal to make dense developer material feel ordered rather than ornamental. The system is refined and tool-like without becoming a systems console.
keyCharacteristics: Code-forward hierarchy with monospaced headings and terminal content.
Cool, low-chroma neutral surfaces in both themes.
Flat tonal layering reinforced by fine borders.
One violet accent for links, focus, selection, and active location.
Restrained, functional transitions and documentation-first density.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Violet identifies the next meaningful action or the current location; it is not a decorative fill for large regions.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Monospace carries structure and executable material; sans-serif carries explanation and operational labels.

rules.name: The Flat Workbench Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are separated by tone and structural rules; shadows are not part of the current depth vocabulary.

dos: Do keep prose centered within the 72ch reading measure.
Do use Signal Violet for navigation, focus, selection, and meaningful actions.
Do use fine borders and tonal contrast to organize technical material.
Do preserve clear light- and dark-mode semantic relationships.
Do keep motion brief, functional, and respectful of reduced-motion needs.
donts: Don't turn the interface into a dense operational dashboard.
Don't introduce decorative gradients, glass effects, or nested card grids.
Don't use semantic status colors as competing brand accents.
Don't add shadows to the incumbent system and describe them as established tokens.
Don't sacrifice body readability for an all-monospace interface.
